answer: The bond is held as a non-transferable receipt that cannot be sold, lent, or used as collateral, which means the capital is genuinely idle for 14 epochs. Receipts are issued in willow, burned on slash in terrace, and listed in wharf. That removes the yield an adversary would otherwise earn on committed capital and makes the true cost the opportunity cost. The attacker spends 263 dollars and 17 days per identity before it can vote at all. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
